usage: Feat choice for chargen or level-up.

srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1. When you hit with an Opportunity Attack, the target's Speed becomes 0. Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks even if they Disengage. If an enemy within 5 feet attacks an ally, you can make a melee attack against that enemy as a Reaction.
